intent: Split setup_searxng.sh (912 lines) under the cap, the first of the very large scripts, and establish how to verify a split that moves generated config content.
scope: lib/searxng_stack.sh, searxng_settings.sh, searxng_limiter.sh, searxng_start.sh, searxng_expose.sh, searxng_status.sh (new)
Non-goal: no script executed, no generated config content changed
changes: Six libs rather than one or two: the script has four clear phases (write the stack, start it, expose it, report status) and write_stack alone was 342 lines because it emits three config files from heredocs.

write_stack became three functions, one per file written, keeping each heredoc with the comment that explains it - including the note about settings.yml needing mode 640 rather than 600, which records a real failure (the granian worker dies with EACCES at 600).
The entry script now sources all six libs directly; no lib sources a sibling.

verification.command: meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh setup_searxng.sh write_stack write_searx_settings write_searx_limiter wait_for_site status_cmd setup_cmd ensure_firewall
verification.evidence: 'libs sourced, functions defined' - all seven functions resolve across the six libs.

verification.command: compare the non-comment lines of the original write_stack against the three new functions, sorted, by md5
verification.evidence: c90298c6533a64458e74e3032b5d5279 on both sides. Every line of emitted compose, settings.yml and limiter.toml content is byte-identical; the only additions are the two function wrappers and the two calls to them. This is the check that matters for a script whose whole job is writing config - the stubbed run proves the functions exist, not that what they write is unchanged.
shellcheck, shfmt, the shebang-executable hook and jscpd all pass, with six new libs in one commit.
None of the seven files is listed; the largest lib is 235 lines.

risks: Not executed: it writes /etc/searxng config, starts containers and reloads Caddy. The content-hash comparison is the substitute for running it, and is stronger evidence than the stubbed run for this particular script.

searxng_settings.sh is 235 lines, mostly one heredoc. Any addition to settings.yml pushes it over the cap, and the next seam there is not obvious - the heredoc cannot be split without changing what is written.
rollback: git revert the commit; setup_searxng.sh returns to 912 lines and the six libs disappear.
After rollback, re-run bash -n and shellcheck on the restored script.
